context.title: Waterloo Busker Carnival returns to uptown this weekend
context.text: Waterloo Busker Carnival returns to uptown this weekend www.therecord.com Waterloo Busker Carnival returns to uptown this weekend Street performers from six countries will take over King Street from Thursday to Sunday for the 38th edition of the free festival. Shows run every hour from noon until 10 p.m., with the headline fire act closing the main stage each night. Organizers say the closure of King Street between Erb and William will start Wednesday evening. Parking is available at the Waterloo Public Square garage. Aug. 18, 2026
